document: Ford Motor Company FY2025 10-K (year ended 31 Dec 2025). The brief and the pre-flight call this document 'Six Flags 2025 10-K'; its text is Ford's (f-20251231.pdf, FORD MOTOR COMPANY AND SUBSIDIARIES).
page_numbering: page N = the intake locator page:N (1-based PDF page index), not the printed folio

units.basis: Title near the top of p115 (printed 111). Revenues to diluted shares, then the next statement title follows on the same page.

Second title in the lower half of p115 (about line 39 of the page text), after the income statement's per-share and share rows; from Net income/(loss) to Comprehensive income/(loss) attributable to Ford Motor Company. Two units share this page.
Title near the top of p116 (printed 112). The VIE table below it (assets and liabilities of consolidated variable interest entities) is a memo table, not part of the balance sheet columns.
Title near the top of p117 (printed 113); all three sections and the cash roll on the one page.
Title near the top of p118 (printed 114); balances at 31 Dec 2022 to 31 Dec 2025, footnotes (a) and (b), then the 'accompanying notes' line.
